They already have music classes with an other provider where they do dancing and singing. They wanted to wait till Riley gets back so skipped this week's session and will start with sports next week. Confirmed with Riley

Spoke to Sonya, they aren't very happy with the sessions, doesn't seem to be very engaging for the children. She seems very interested and asked to send through some details. She also mentioned that they have like 4-5 different rooms so the 1 hour session seems to be rushed.

Spoke to Sonya (education leader), she wasn't in but checked with the educators, they said energy could have been a bit better with the younger ones but the preschoolers were engaged, will give me more feedback after tomorrows sessions. Coach details sent (Steph and Alana)
Spoke to Sonya(education leader), she confirmed that we can start the sessions with Lara next week ( till Riley gets back). Emailed Lara's details.

Were fully settled with Riley and love having her at their centre. in the lead up to riley's time away Fiori took over, however Fiori resigned and with Lara's uni commitments noone was free to take over. Centre would obviously prefer to have sessions now (we are actively recruiting music coaches) but are content to wait until Riley returns in July. Lara is happy to take over once she is fully recovered (still having some fatigue) now that uni has wrapped up
The sessions are much improved, no complaints!
